title: Term Life Insurance Premium Mode Changes
content:
**Service Center guidance — Term Life Insurance premium modes.**

The owner may choose annual, semiannual, quarterly or monthly EFT mode. A premium mode change is accepted only while the policy status on record is in force or grace period.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Effective timing | With the first installment due on or after the request |
| Change to annual mode | Where the product's annual-mode anniversary rule applies (it does on every tier), takes effect only on the next policy anniversary; the current mode continues until then |
| Monthly EFT | Requires a draft day from 1 to the product's latest draft day and a bank account in the owner's name; refused while an EFT privilege termination is within its re-enrollment wait under the returned-payment rules |
| Change of draft day alone | Takes effect with the next draft |
| Installments already billed | Keep their amounts |

### Status table

| Policy status on record | Mode change accepted? |
|---|---|
| in force | yes |
| grace period | yes |
| any other status | no |

### Hypothetical cases

- A request on 10 May to move from quarterly to semiannual on a policy with installments due 1 July: the change takes effect with the 1 July installment.
- A request on 10 May to move to annual mode on a policy whose anniversary is 1 September: the current mode continues and annual mode takes effect on 1 September.
- A request for monthly EFT three months after a return that ended the EFT privilege, with a 6-month wait: refused.
